description: FULL BODY. A Malaysian male in his late 30s with short, neat black hair. He is wearing a formal dark blue Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) uniform with silver buttons, epaulettes, and a visible name tag on his chest. He wears black trousers and polished black leather boots.

FULL BODY. A young Malaysian man in his early 20s with a modern undercut hairstyle. He is wearing a casual festive outfit consisting of a red and gold patterned Batik shirt with short sleeves, dark denim jeans, and white sneakers.

FULL BODY. An anonymous human figure depicted as a featureless, pitch-black silhouette. The figure wears a dark hooded sweatshirt with the hood pulled up, obscuring all facial features, and dark trousers. A faint digital static effect outlines the figure.
